idea-plugin.name: Mycel Language
idea-plugin.description:
Support for the Mycel language (.myc and .olx files): syntax highlighting (keywords, types, f-strings with {x} interpolation, comments, numbers, operators), brace matching, Cmd+/ commenting, a Run Configuration with gutter run icons on fn main and test blocks (mycel run / mycel test), and inline errors and warnings from mycel check --json with their explanations and suggested fixes.

Mycel is in development and its command-line tool is not publicly released yet: highlighting and the color schemes work on their own; inline errors and running programs need the mycel tool (on your PATH, or set in the run configuration). Try the language now in the browser: ol1x.xyz/mycel/play.

More about the language: ol1x.xyz/mycel.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: first Marketplace release. Highlighting, Mycel Dark and Mycel Light color schemes, color settings page, run configurations and gutter run icons, inline diagnostics from mycel check --json.
